rules: A router must be selected (via /routers or discovery) before performing Hotspot or User Manager operations.
Router passwords are encrypted using Fernet cryptography prior to saving in SQLite.
Batch Hotspot card generation is capped at 500 cards per request to prevent API exhaustion.
Discovered routers cannot be edited unless saved with valid admin credentials.
A super_admin cannot revoke their own super_admin role via /roles.
Hotspot user cards generate unique numeric usernames to prevent router duplicate key collisions.
Watchdog automatically marks routers as OFFLINE after failed connection retries and notifies admins.
Expired Hotspot users are automatically purged daily if configured in the backup scheduler.
